definitions.explanation: Describes a place that is calm and free from noise and bustle. Typically used for residential areas, neighborhoods, and districts that are removed from the hustle of commercial zones.

examples.japanese: {閑静|かんせい}な⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a quiet residential area.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{閑静|かんせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らし→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧やすい⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a quiet and comfortable place to live.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧{閑静|かんせい}な⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The inn was on a quiet street a little distance from the station.

notes:
Compound of {閑|かん} (leisure/quiet) + {静|せい} (calm/still). Almost always used to describe places, especially residential areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閑静|かんせい}な⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧ (quiet residential area) — the most common collocation
- {閑静|かんせい}な⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧ (quiet street)
- {閑静|かんせい}な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (quiet place)

USAGE:
{閑静|かんせい} has a positive nuance, suggesting pleasant peacefulness. It is different from ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧, which is more general and neutral. {閑静|かんせい} specifically implies refined quietness appropriate for living, while ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧ can describe any quiet state.
